intro: Organic search and paid media built to put you in front of high-intent buyers and turn their searches into qualified leads.

cards.name: Technical & on-page SEO
cards.alt: Magnifying glass catching teal light over scattered blank paper cards
cards.line: Fast, crawlable pages with clean structure, metadata and schema, so search engines understand your site and rank it for the right terms.

cards.name: Content & link strategy
cards.alt: Chain of dark metal links with one link glowing teal
cards.line: Keyword-led content plans and earned links that build authority, answer real buyer questions and keep organic traffic growing.

cards.name: Google Ads campaigns
cards.alt: Lighthouse beam sweeping across a dark sea at night
cards.line: Search and Performance Max campaigns structured around intent, with tight keywords, strong ads and budgets aimed at your best customers.

cards.name: Paid media management
cards.alt: Hand moving a chess piece on a dark chessboard
cards.line: Hands-on management of your ad accounts, from bids and budgets to audiences and creative, so your spend goes where it performs best.

cards.name: Conversion tracking
cards.alt: Arrow struck in the centre of a dark target
cards.line: Calls, forms and purchases measured properly in GA4 and Google Ads, so every campaign optimises towards the leads that actually matter.

cards.name: Reporting & optimisation
cards.alt: Hands holding a tablet showing rising teal bars
cards.line: Clear reports that show what each channel delivers, with ongoing tests that improve results instead of just describing them.
